captions_note: the pane words are not captions: keep the reel's captions on; build with CAPTIONS=0 if they say the same thing twice
steps: run build.py      # 1. track, measure, choose the layout, plan, index.html. READ the printout

run post.py      # 5. frame count, phone copy, stills, work/qa/sheet_*.jpg
